Thanks Marissa — read and reviewed. A couple quick points:

- Candidate looks like a high upside hire for runtime infra work; I agree manager signal is strong.
- We should avoid a knee-jerk IC4 unless there's a clear comp defensibility case (unique skills + direct hires at that band in last 6 months).

Laura / Rohan — can you confirm whether we've recently approved band 7 for similar backend hires in EMEA? If not, I'd prefer we confirm IC3 but offer an accelerated promotion plan and a sign-on to bridge competing offers.

If you think IC4 is necessary, please outline the business case (peer comps, hard-to-fill rationale) — I can escalate to comp committee for same-day review.
